    r.P = 9e4

    s.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    s.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
    s.Parent = ac
    l = true
    a9()
end

    l = false

b.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not l or not r or not s then return end
    f = e.Character
    if not f then return end
    local ac = f:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    local af = g.CFrame
    r.CFrame = af
    local ag = ad.MoveDirection
    local ah = m * n
    local ai = Vector3.zero
    if ag.Magnitude > 0.05 then
        local aj = Vector3.new(af.LookVector.X, 0, af.LookVector.Z)
        if aj.Magnitude > 0.001 then
            aj = aj.Unit
            local ak = Vector3.new(af.RightVector.X, 0, af.RightVector.Z).Unit
            local al = ag:Dot(aj)
            local am = ag:Dot(ak)
            local an = af.LookVector * al + af.RightVector * am
            if an.Magnitude > 0.01 then
                ai = an.Unit * ah
            else
                ai = ag * ah
            end
        else
            ai = af.LookVector * ah
        end
    end
    if o then
        ai = ai + (af.UpVector * ah)
    elseif p then
        ai = ai - (af.UpVector * ah)
    end
    s.Velocity = ai
end)
